 Parts

 This page lists every biological part used in PAGER-Yeast, grouped into three functional modules: signal recognition, signal transduction optimisation, and signal reporter. Each part carries its identifier, name and description, with long sequences available to expand. 本页列出 PAGER-Yeast 项目中使用的全部生物元件，按信号识别、信号转导优化、信号报告三个功能模块归置。每个元件给出编号、名称与描述，长序列可展开查看。 

 18 parts across 3 functional modules 18 个元件，分布于 3 个功能模块 

 Part identifiers are filled in once registration is complete; each identifier on the left then links to its Registry page. 元件编号将在完成登记后填入，届时每一条目左侧的编号即指向 Registry 页面。 

 Signal Recognition Module 信号识别模块 

 Recognises the influenza A HA antigen; built from a signal peptide, an inhibitory domain, a nanobody, a cleavage site and a receptor joined in sequence. 负责识别甲型流感病毒 HA 抗原，由信号肽、抑制域、纳米抗体、酶切位点与受体依次串成。 

 Part ID 元件 ID 
 Part name 元件名称 
 Description 元件描述 

 — 
 α-factor signal peptide (SP) α-factor 信号肽（SP） 
 Signal peptide. Guides the fusion protein into the secretory pathway and anchors it on the yeast plasma membrane. 信号肽。引导融合蛋白进入分泌途径并锚定在酵母细胞膜上。 
 Sequence 序列 ATGAGATTTCCTTCTATTTTTACTGCTGTTTTGTTTGCTGCTTCTTCTGCTTTAGCA 

 — 
 MT1 (muscarinic toxin 1), C-terminally truncated fragment MT1（毒蕈碱毒素 1）C 端截短片段 
 Inhibitory domain. Self-inhibition switch that binds and blocks hM1Dq when no antigen is present. 抑制域。自抑制开关，无抗原时结合并抑制 hM1Dq。 
 Sequence 序列 TTGACTTGTGTTACTTCTAAATCAATTTTTGGTATTACTACTGAAAATTGTCCTGATGGTCAAAATTTGTGTTTTAAAAAATGGTATTATATAGTTCCTAGATATTCTGATATAACATGGGGTTGTGCAGCTACTTGTCCTAAACCAACTAATGTTAGAGAAACTATTAGATGTTGTGAAACAGAT 

 — 
 H1N1 HA nanobody R1a-B6 (stem-binding) H1N1 HA 纳米抗体 R1a-B6（结合茎部） 
 Nanobody. Binds the influenza A HA stem specifically; the core recognition unit of the whole cascade. 纳米抗体。特异性结合甲型流感病毒 HA 茎部，是整条链路的核心识别单元。 
 Sequence 序列  

 — 
 TEV protease cleavage site (TEVcs) TEV 蛋白酶切位点（TEVcs） 
 Protease cleavage site. Molecular switch for in-vitro verification, used to mimic antigen unlocking. 蛋白酶切位点。体外功能验证用的分子开关，可模拟抗原解锁。 
 Sequence 序列 GAAAATTTGTACTTTCAATCA 

 — 
 hM1Dq (human M1 DREADD receptor) hM1Dq（人源 M1 DREADD 受体） 
 Receptor. Receives the upstream signal and couples to the downstream G-protein pathway; activated by DCZ. 受体。接收上游信号并偶联下游 G 蛋白通路，可被 DCZ 激活。 
 Sequence 序列  

 — 
 HA protein (influenza A hemagglutinin) HA 蛋白（甲型流感病毒血凝素） 
 Antigen. The detection target of this project, used for antigen stimulation in functional assays. 抗原。本项目的检测目标，用于功能测试中的抗原刺激。 
 Sequence 序列  

 Signal Transduction Optimization Module 信号转导优化模块 

 Cuts background, releases growth and amplifies the signal; holds the three-gene knockout elements and the Gpa1 humanisation fragment. 负责降低背景、释放生长、放大信号，包含三基因敲除元件与 Gpa1 人源化改造片段。 

 Part ID 元件 ID 
 Part name 元件名称 
 Description 元件描述 

 — 
 URA3 (with promoter and terminator) URA3（含启动子与终止子） 
 Selection marker. Uracil selection marker for picking positive integrants on SD-Ura plates. 筛选标记。尿嘧啶营养筛选标记，在 SD-Ura 平板上筛选阳性整合克隆。 
 Sequence 序列  

 — 
 500 bp upstream homology arm at the GPA1 edit site GPA1 改造位点前 500 bp 上游同源臂 
 Homology arm. Upstream arm of the integration fragment, used for site-directed replacement of the Gpa1 C-terminus. 同源臂。同源重组整合片段的上游臂，用于定点替换 Gpa1 C 端。 
 Sequence 序列  

 — 
 Humanised replacement sequence (EYNLV + stop codon) 人源化替换序列（EYNLV + 终止密码子） 
 Edit site. Replaces the Gpa1 C-terminal KIGII with EYNLV so hM1Dq can couple to the yeast MAPK pathway. 改造位点。把 Gpa1 C 端 KIGII 换成 EYNLV，使 hM1Dq 能与酵母 MAPK 通路偶联。 
 Sequence 序列 GAATATAATTTGGTTTGA 

 — 
 500 bp downstream homology arm at the GPA1 edit site GPA1 改造位点后 500 bp 下游同源臂 
 Homology arm. Downstream arm of the integration fragment; together with the upstream arm it defines the replaced region. 同源臂。同源重组整合片段的下游臂，与上游臂共同界定替换区间。 
 Sequence 序列  

 — 
 SpCas9 (from pML104) SpCas9（来自 pML104） 
 Nuclease. CRISPR nuclease guided by the sgRNA to create a double-strand break at the target site. 核酸酶。CRISPR 编辑用核酸酶，由 sgRNA 引导在靶位点产生双链断裂。 
 Sequence 序列  

 — 
 sgRNA (FAR1) sgRNA（FAR1） 
 Guide RNA. Guides SpCas9 to cut the FAR1 locus for knockout of that gene. 向导 RNA。引导 SpCas9 切割 FAR1 位点，实现该基因敲除。 
 Sequence 序列 GCAGTGAAAGATAAATGATCACCAAGTTTGAAGAAAACAGGTTTTAGAGCTAGAAATAGCAAGTTAAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAA 

 — 
 sgRNA (STE2) sgRNA（STE2） 
 Guide RNA. Guides SpCas9 to cut the STE2 locus for knockout of that gene. 向导 RNA。引导 SpCas9 切割 STE2 位点，实现该基因敲除。 
 Sequence 序列 GCAGTGAAAGATAAATGATCTCACCTCTACTGATGAACTGGTTTTAGAGCTAGAAATAGCAAGTTAAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAA 

 — 
 sgRNA (Sst2) sgRNA（Sst2） 
 Guide RNA. Guides SpCas9 to cut the Sst2 locus for knockout of that gene. 向导 RNA。引导 SpCas9 切割 Sst2 位点，实现该基因敲除。 
 Sequence 序列 GCAGTGAAAGATAAATGATCACACCGCAGGACAGAACTCGGTTTTAGAGCTAGAAATAGCAAGTTAAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAA 

 Signal Reporter Module 信号报告模块 

 Turns pathway activation into a readable signal; holds the promoter plus fluorescent and colourimetric reporters. 把通路激活转成可读出信号，含启动子与荧光、显色两类报告基因。 

 Part ID 元件 ID 
 Part name 元件名称 
 Description 元件描述 

 — 
 yEGFP (yeast-optimised enhanced GFP) yEGFP（酵母优化型绿色荧光蛋白） 
 Reporter. Green fluorescent reporter read out quantitatively by flow cytometry. 报告基因。绿色荧光报告基因，用流式细胞术做定量读数。 
 Sequence 序列  

 — 
 FUS1 promoter FUS1 启动子 
 Promoter. G-protein-responsive promoter that drives reporter transcription once the pathway is activated. 启动子。G 蛋白响应启动子，通路激活后启动下游报告基因转录。 
 Sequence 序列  

 — 
 MEL1 (alpha-galactosidase) MEL1（α-半乳糖苷酶） 
 Reporter. Secreted reporter kept as an alternative readout for the output stage. 报告基因。分泌型报告基因，用于报告输出的备选读出方式。 
 Sequence 序列  

 — 
 LACZα (with multiple cloning site) LACZα（含多克隆位点） 
 Reporter. β-galactosidase α fragment carrying a multiple cloning site; read out by X-Gal staining. 报告基因。β-半乳糖苷酶 α 片段，带多克隆位点，可用 X-Gal 显色判读。
